   Firebase Cloud Functions 2nd Gen Scheduler does not work correctly on the emulators.   #5875 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Closed #5891 Closed Firebase Cloud Functions 2nd Gen Scheduler does not work correctly on the emulators. #5875 #5891 Copy link Assignees   Labels emulators: functions reproducible Description gladevise opened  on May 22, 2023 Issue body actions 
 Firebase Cloud Functions 2nd Gen Scheduler does not work correctly on the emulators. 
 When I start the emulators and try to execute a function with  firebase functions:shell  , the following error occurs. 
 firebase  >   scheduleTestV2 ()
 ' Successfully invoked function. ' 
firebase  >  ⚠  functions: TypeError: req.header is not a function
    at httpFunc (/home/username/workspace/tests/firebase-cloud-functions-schedule-v2-not-working-emulator/functions/node_modules/.pnpm/firebase-functions@4.3.1_firebase-admin@11.8.0/node_modules/firebase-functions/lib/v2/providers/scheduler.js:63:26)
    at /home/username/workspace/tests/firebase-cloud-functions-schedule-v2-not-working-emulator/functions/node_modules/.pnpm/firebase-functions@4.3.1_firebase-admin@11.8.0/node_modules/firebase-functions/lib/v2/trace.js:16:28
    at /home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/emulator/functionsEmulatorRuntime.js:524:16
    at runFunction (/home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/emulator/functionsEmulatorRuntime.js:506:15)
    at runCloudEvent (/home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/emulator/functionsEmulatorRuntime.js:523:11)
    at processBackground (/home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/emulator/functionsEmulatorRuntime.js:490:16)
    at /home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/emulator/functionsEmulatorRuntime.js:689:27
    at Layer.handle [as handle_request] (/home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/node_modules/express/lib/router/layer.js:95:5)
    at next (/home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/node_modules/express/lib/router/route.js:144:13)
    at next (/home/username/.nvm/versions/node/v18.16.0/lib/node_modules/firebase-tools/node_modules/express/lib/router/route.js:140:7)
⚠  Your  function   was  killed because it raised an unhandled error. 
 I have confirmed that the 1st Gen scheduler functions work fine in the same environment. 
 firebase  >   scheduleTestV1 ()
 ' Successfully invoked function. ' 
firebase  >   >   { " severity " : " INFO " , " message " : " scheduleTestV1 called at 2023-05-22T04:15:25.128Z " } 
 [REQUIRED] Version info 
 node: v18.16.0
firebase-functions: ^4.3.1
firebase-admin: ^11.8.0
firebase-tools: 12.1.0
 
 [REQUIRED] Test case 
 I have published code in the following repository that can reproduce the error. 
 https://github.com/gladevise/firebase-cloud-functions-schedule-v2-not-working-emulator 
 [REQUIRED] Steps to reproduce 
 You can reproduce the error by executing the command in the following steps. 
 git clone https://github.com/gladevise/firebase-cloud-functions-schedule-v2-not-working-emulator

cd firebase-cloud-functions-schedule-v2-not-working-emulator/functions

pnpm install

pnpm run serve
 
 Run the following on another terminal 
 pnpm run shell
